vb_textbox.text: you will see 2 sets of gnomes in this game.  red/purple and brown & grey. one of each set of gnomes appear on the left or right side, you have to choose which one you think you will get more mushrooms from. Sometimes the one you choose you will get a high amount of mushrooms, maybe 7 or 8, sometimes only 1 or 0, you have to switch between them to try and get most mushrooms
